description: Personal-record badges on the sets of the workout being logged. previous holds the exercise's sets from earlier finished workouts; only completed sets with reps > 0 count, missing weight = 0. Sets are taken in order and a set gets a badge for each best it strictly beats: the best of previous and of the earlier sets of this workout. With no counting previous set there are no badges. Kinds, in this order: oneRepMax (Epley), weight, volume (weight × reps of one set), reps.

cases.name: sets that were not ticked are not history
